note: Original FakeBackend.invoke responses, not MCP/native results. The /fixtures path is the built-in synthetic identity; no waveform file is read. Tick = 1 ps. IDs and completeness are preserved.

limitations: Recording/dump coverage is not established by a completed backend scan.
Joint expressions use final values per timestamp; intermediate cross-signal truth is unavailable.
Cooperative timeout bounds scheduling, not a blocking vendor call.
quality.interpretation_rule: Complete buckets describe inspected recorded data; absence in simulation additionally requires recording coverage.
quality.raw_count_semantics: recorded_event_count counts dependency records, value_change_count counts noninitial dependency value changes, stable_change_count counts track final-value changes.
quality.duration_semantics: Stable final-per-tick physical duration between the closed query endpoints; point witnesses have zero duration.
